items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: Yeah, sometime I worked with him, but I never just played in his band. I used to play extra sometimes.

ctx.x: Did you ever work with Buddy Petit?

Yeah, sometime I worked with him, but I never just played in his band. I used to play extra sometimes. Yeah, exactly. And we used to hire him plenty of times. Because with this little band here, or this last band I played, Ernest Milton. But that's where Buddy was playing second con with the Ernest Milton when he died. Oh, yeah. Yeah. Buddy was supposed to go with him, a place down there that he used to call Burwood. He used to go down there and play with him. Well, that job coming up that Saturday, well, he'd…
Yeah, he died in a sudden.
